shortBio: Automation Architect building intelligent testing systems and exploring Agentic AI.
fullBio:
Over the past 11 years, I've grown from a QA Engineer writing test cases to an Automation Architect building intelligent systems. I've led quality engineering teams, designed automation platforms, and served as a Scrum Master — always focused on one thing: helping teams ship faster without breaking things.

Today, I'm building at the intersection of Quality Engineering and Agentic AI. I use LangChain, MCP, local LLMs, and DeepEval to explore how engineering teams can build software faster with intelligent automation. I write about what I learn, experiment with new tools daily, and turn ideas into practical proof of concepts.

whatIdo.title: AI & LLM Engineering
capabilities: Orchestrate LLM workflows with LangChain and MCP
Build RAG systems with local and cloud models
Evaluate AI quality with DeepEval pipelines
Integrate Copilot and AI assistants into dev workflows

whatIdo.title: Test Automation & Architecture
capabilities: Design E2E frameworks with Playwright and Selenium
Build API testing with REST Assured and Postman
Shift Left quality — test earlier, fail cheaper

whatIdo.title: Development & Cloud
capabilities: Spring Boot, Node.js, React for full-stack delivery
Docker, Kubernetes, Azure for cloud infrastructure
Jenkins, GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines

philosophy: I believe quality starts long before execution — whether it's Shift Left principles, AI-assisted workflows, or building tools that eliminate repetitive work. The goal is always the same: help engineers spend less time on manual effort and more time solving meaningful problems.
